safety.title: Before you contact the owner
safety.intro: A few rules keep you safe from scams:
safety.point1: Never pay before you've checked the owner and seen the place, in person or on a live video call.
safety.point2: Don't send money by bank transfer, Bit, PayBox, crypto or gift cards to someone you haven't verified.
safety.point3: {siteName} will never send you a payment link in a chat.
safety.video: ask the owner to show the apartment and a paper with today's date and the listing ID (<ltr>{id}</ltr>).
